confirm_call.meaning: A transaction invokes confirmWithdrawal or batchConfirmWithdrawals on StakingManager.

withdrawal_paused.meaning: The contract's withdrawal-specific pause is active (withdrawal functionality paused).

hype_withdrawn.meaning: The user's queued HYPE withdrawal is finalized and tokens leave the contract.

queued_withdrawal_ready.meaning: A queued HYPE withdrawal has passed the mandatory delay and is ready to finalize.

withdrawal_pause_protective.meaning: The active withdrawal pause is intended to protect the contract (e.g. suspected exploit or liquidity issue).

claims.scope: Confirmation of a ready queued HYPE withdrawal while the withdrawal pause is active.

preconditions.text: A ready queued withdrawal is being confirmed and the withdrawal-specific pause may be active.
preconditions.derivation: queued_withdrawal_delay supplies the delayed queued withdrawal being finalized; pauses_during_emergencies supplies a possibly active withdrawal pause.

safety.text: While withdrawal functionality is paused, a confirmation call must not finalize/withdraw HYPE.
safety.derivation: intended_withdrawal_pause_control states whenWithdrawalNotPaused is intended to block withdrawals when withdrawal functionality is paused, so an active pause must prevent withdrawal finalization.

effects.text: Confirmation still finalizes the withdrawal while the pause is active, so HYPE is withdrawn during a pause and the pause/security controls are undermined.
effects.derivation: security_controls_violated and pause_enforcement_undermined describe the protocol losing withdrawal control because the withdrawal proceeds while the pause is active.

effect_coverage.reason: Effects AST is the negation of the safety obligation under withdrawal_paused.
Failure to block withdrawal while withdrawal_paused witnesses the undermined enforcement.

assumptions: Neither confirmWithdrawal nor batchConfirmWithdrawals includes whenWithdrawalNotPaused; only whenNotPaused (general pause) is applied.
Report asserts whenWithdrawalNotPaused is the intended/available withdrawal-pause control, unverified against contract source.
A queued HYPE withdrawal has passed its mandatory delay and is confirmable.
unresolved: Whether the active pause in any real incident is withdrawal-specific or only general is unstated.
No evidence an incident occurred; impact remains potential.
Concrete actor, timing and call order beyond the generic confirm-then-withdraw flow are unspecified.

claims.scope: User withdrawal during a protective withdrawal pause intended to safeguard the contract.

preconditions.text: A ready queued withdrawal is confirmed while a withdrawal pause may be active.
preconditions.derivation: queued_withdrawal_delay gives the confirmable queued withdrawal; pauses_during_emergencies gives the possibly active withdrawal pause.

safety.text: While withdrawal functionality is paused, a confirmation call must not finalize/withdraw HYPE.
safety.derivation: intended_withdrawal_pause_control: the withdrawal pause is meant to block withdrawal finalization, including when the pause protects the contract.

effects.text: A user withdraws HYPE while a protective withdrawal pause (e.g. suspected exploit) is active.
effects.derivation: unauthorized_fund_drains describes users withdrawing HYPE during a pause intended to protect the contract, e.g. a suspected exploit.

effect_coverage.reason: Only the conditional withdrawal during a protective pause is expressible; drained HYPE amount/value and the 'unauthorized' entitlement cannot be expressed with allowed operators.

assumptions: The pause is intended to protect the contract during emergencies such as a suspected exploit or liquidity issue.
A queued HYPE withdrawal is ready to confirm at the time of the protective pause.
unresolved: Whether any exploit, liquidity issue or fund loss actually occurred; impact is conditional/potential.
No economic quantification of the drain is available.
No concrete triggering actor or ordering is given.

limitations: withdraw_while_paused is an action statement, not an impact; per the V-source rule it is not listed as an impact_id, and its content (confirm + withdrawal_paused + hype_withdrawn) is captured by the effects AST.
unauthorized_fund_drains coverage is partial: economic magnitude and entitlement are inexpressible.
pause_enforcement_undermined is representable only as failure of the withdrawal-pause obligation, not as a governance/permission quantity.
Root-cause statements (missing_modifier, only_general_pause_used, bypass_withdrawal_restrictions) are code premises, not encoded as P/I/V.
No secondary timing, persistence, population-wide or refund claims were generated per core scope.
The gap between withdrawal-specific and general pause states is unresolved rather than assumed active.
